title: Your PC remembers everything you copy #shorts
description:
Windows has a built-in clipboard history. Press Windows key + V to see and paste things you copied earlier, and pin the ones you use often.

#windows #techtips #pctips #productivity #shorts

points.d: and turn on clipboard history once.
it keeps your recent text and images.
pinned items stay even after a restart.

fix:
Press Windows + V
to paste older copies
fix_sub: Clear it anytime from the same panel.
question: Did you know this shortcut? Yes or No in the comments
